== Remove files from devices with Kobiton CLI

The new `kobiton file rm` command removes a file or an empty folder from an Android or iOS device in a CLI session.

- A successful removal prints `Removed <path>` and exits `0`.
- A removal fails with a non-zero exit status when the path does not exist or the folder still contains files.

For details, see xref:kobiton-cli:cli-commands.adoc#file-rm[`file rm`].
